entries.question: Aaj kgmu me opd dekhi jayegi
entries.answer:

कृपया ध्यान दें:
1. OPD में दिखाने के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप www.ors.gov.in पर अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं या 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333 पर कॉल कर सकते हैं।

3. यदि आप शहर के बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) साथ लाएं।
4. लंबी प्रतीक्षा से बचने के लिए पहले से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करना उचित है।

मैं एक AI सहायक हूँ और चिकित्सा सलाह देने के लिए योग्य नहीं हूँ। यदि आपको कोई स्वास्थ्य समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU OPD में डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें या हेल्पलाइन पर संपर्क करें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए कृपया इस चैट में कोई भी व्यक्तिगत विवरण (जैसे आधार नंबर या फोन नंबर) साझा न करें।

entries.question: Clerk job ke liye apply kese kre
entries.answer:
KGMU mein kisi bhi non-teaching ya clerk job ki vacancy ke liye aapko samay-samay par university ki official website **[www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)** par "Career" ya "Recruitment" section ko check karte rehna hoga.

Jab bhi koi vacancy nikalti hai, to uski puri jankari (eligibility, application process, aur link) website par notice board ya recruitment section mein upload kar di jati hai.

Aap in steps ko follow karein:
1. **Official Website visit karein:** [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)
2. **Recruitment/Career Section:** Website ke menu mein "Recruitment" ya "Notice Board" ka section dekhein.
3. **Notifications:** Wahan par nikalne wali vacancy ka PDF download karke usme diye gaye instructions padhein.
4. **Online/Offline Apply:** Agar online application ka link diya gaya hoga, to wahan se apply karein. Agar form download karke bhejna hoga, to uske liye diye gaye instructions ka palan karein.

**Dhyan dein:** Kisi bhi third-party ya fake website par apni personal details ya paise na dein. Hamesha sirf official domain (.org) wali website par hi bharosa karein.

Main KGMU AI Assistant hoon, jise Dr. Ayush Yadav ne banaya hai. Agar aapko kisi specific department ya website ke kisi aur section ke baare mein jaanna ho, to aap pooch sakte hain.

entries.question: Book apointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, please use one of the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (Recommended)**
*   Visit: [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Flow:** Select State (Uttar Pradesh) → Select Hospital (King George's Medical University) → Click 'New Appointment' → Choose Department, Date & Time → Enter patient details → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **ORS** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the online portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a confirmation regarding your booking.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   Visit the OPD registration counters at KGMU.
*   **Requirements:** You must carry the patient's **Aadhaar card** and an active **mobile number** to receive the OTP.
*   **Fee:** ₹50 (payable at the counter).
*   **Note:** Counters close at **1:00 PM** (Mon–Fri) and **12:00 PM** (Sat). Arriving early is strongly recommended as tokens are limited.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Outside-city patients:** Please bring a valid referral letter for your specific department.
*   **Emergency:** If this is a medical emergency, do not wait for an appointment; please proceed directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**.
*   **Safety:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**. Please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or contact information in this chat.

2. **Mobile App:** Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same booking flow as the ORS portal.
3. **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT <YOUR NAME>" to **8887019134**.
4. **On-Site (Walk-in):** You can register at the OPD counters by providing your Aadhaar number and an active mobile number to receive an OTP. 

**Important Information:**
* **OPD Fee:** ₹50 flat for the OPD slip (payable via all booking methods).
* **Timings:** Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM | Saturday: 9:00 AM–12:00 PM. (Closed on Sundays).
* **Referrals:** Patients from outside the city must bring a valid referral for their specific department.
* **Pro-Tip:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

entries.question: Appointment book karna chahta hun
entries.answer:
KGMU mein appointment book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon mein se kisi ek ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1. **Online Portal (ORS):** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jakar 'New Appointment' select karein, phir state mein 'Uttar Pradesh' aur hospital mein 'KGMU' chunein.
2. **Mobile App:** Aap 'ABHA' ya 'Health Care' app download karke bhi appointment book kar sakte hain.
3. **SMS Booking:** Apna naam lekar "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.
4. **Helpline:** Aap 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par call karke bhi jankari le sakte hain.
5. **Walk-in:** Aap seedhe hospital jakar bhi registration counter par apna Aadhaar card dikhakar token le sakte hain (isliye subah jaldi aana behtar hai).

**Zaroori baatein:**
* OPD ki fee ₹50 hai.
* OPD ka samay: Som-Shukra (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
* Bahar ke shehron se aane wale mareezon ke liye sambandhit vibhag ka referral lana anivarya hai.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.

entries.question: Lari hospital mein appointment book karna chahta hun Lucknow
entries.answer:
Lari Cardiology (Lari Hospital) mein appointment book karne ke liye aap wahi tareeke apna sakte hain jo KGMU ke liye hain, kyunki Lari Cardiology KGMU ka hi ek hissa hai:

1. **Online Booking:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jaakar hospital list mein 'King George's Medical University' select karein aur department mein 'Cardiology' chunein.
2. **SMS:** "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.
3. **Helpline:** Aap 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par call karke bhi madad le sakte hain.
4. **Direct Visit:** Aap Lari Cardiology ke registration counter par jakar bhi apna Aadhaar card dikhakar ₹50 ki parchi banwa sakte hain.

**Kuch zaroori jaankari:**
* **OPD Timing:** Som-Shukra (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM).
* **Emergency:** Agar koi emergency hai, toh seedhe Trauma Centre (Gate 14) ya Lari Cardiology ki emergency mein jayein.
* **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow se bahar ke rehne wale hain, toh apne saath kisi doctor ka referral zaroor layein.
